tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.desc: All-in-one marketing platform for email campaigns and more
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
Requires internet connection, unusable offline
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the Mailchimp homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: Mailchimp is an all-in-one marketing platform designed to streamline email campaigns, manage social media, create beautiful websites, and sell products online. Key features include customizable email templates, audience segmentation, A/B testing, and analytics. It is ideal for small to medium-sized businesses looking to grow their customer base and engage with their audience effectively. Mailchimp's user-friendly interface and comprehensive tools make it accessible for beginners while offering advanced features for experienced marketers. Pros include its ease of use, wide range of integrations, and affordable pricing plans. Limitations include a lack of advanced segmentation options and limited customization for some templates.
